acceptance_criteria: In prepare_task_prompt, when task.get('partial_edit') is truthy OR the resolved meta_task_type is in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES, the appended prompt block is the __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ surgical-patch block (not the __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ multi-file block).

In _validate_submission, when task.get('partial_edit') is truthy OR the resolved meta_task_type is in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES, validation runs the git_integration._parse_patches patch-list path (validating each patch entry's 'code' block) rather than the whole-file manifest / single-file fallback path.

meta_task_type is resolved consistently using task.get('meta_task_type') or task.get('constraints', {}).get('meta_task_type'), matching the existing resolution pattern at orchestrator.py:900 and :1783.

Non-bypass, non-partial_edit tasks are unchanged: multi-file (len(files_touched) > 1) tasks still emit/validate __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__, and single-file tasks still use the single-file prompt and AST validation.
Only harness/orchestrator.py is modified; no other files change and no general scheduling/execution logic is altered.

edge_cases: task has partial_edit truthy but meta_task_type not in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES: still takes the patches path (OR condition).
task has meta_task_type in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES but partial_edit unset/false: now takes the patches path via the bypass clause.
meta_task_type missing on the task but present under constraints.meta_task_type: resolved value must still be honored.
meta_task_type is None or unrecognized (not in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES) and partial_edit falsy: unchanged manifest/single-file behavior.
Bypass-eligible single-file task (len(files_touched) <= 1): previously got the plain single-file prompt; now gets the __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ block.

Bypass task whose submission contains no parseable __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ block: behavior falls through exactly as the current partial_edit branch does (agent is told to fix its submission via the single-file fallback validation path).
Bypass-eligible multi-file task must NOT emit/require __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ (the patches condition must precede the len>1 manifest branch in both functions).
functional_requirements: FR1: In prepare_task_prompt (harness/orchestrator.py:~782), resolve the effective meta_task_type via task.get('meta_task_type') or task.get('constraints', {}).get('meta_task_type'), and append the __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ partial-edit prompt block when task.get('partial_edit') is truthy OR that resolved meta_task_type is in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES; this condition must take precedence over the multi-file manifest branch so a bypass-eligible multi-file task still receives the patches block.

FR2: In _validate_submission (harness/orchestrator.py:~926), resolve the same effective meta_task_type and run the git_integration._parse_patches patch-list validation branch (per-entry validate_code on each patch 'code' block) when task.get('partial_edit') is truthy OR the resolved meta_task_type is in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES; the existing _parse_manifest branch still wins if a manifest is actually present, but the patch branch must be reachable for bypass tasks that emit no manifest.

FR3: Preserve all existing behavior for tasks that are neither partial_edit nor bypass-eligible: multi-file tasks (len(files_touched) > 1) keep the __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ prompt block and manifest/manifest_missing validation, and single-file tasks keep the unchanged single-file prompt and AST-validation fallback.
spec.implementation_notes: In prepare_task_prompt the current control flow is: `if task.get('partial_edit'): <patches block> elif isinstance(files_touched, list) and len(files_touched) > 1: <manifest block>`. Compute `mtt = task.get('meta_task_type') or task.get('constraints', {}).get('meta_task_type')` near the top of the function and broaden the first condition to `if task.get('partial_edit') or mtt in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES:`, leaving the elif manifest branch for the remaining multi-file case. In _validate_submission the _parse_manifest(code) branch already comes first and returns when a manifest is present (leave it intact). Broaden the subsequent `if task.get('partial_edit'):` (orchestrator.py:926) to `if task.get('partial_edit') or mtt in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES:`, reusing the `mtt` value already resolved at orchestrator.py:900 for allow_nondet (hoist/reuse that local rather than recomputing). Keep the existing fall-through comment semantics for the no-parseable-patches case. Match the existing resolution idiom exactly so constraints-nested meta_task_type is honored. Add a short dated rationale comment (BYPASS_WHOLE_FILE) at each edit site consistent with the file's existing G-series comment style.
spec.interfaces: No signature changes. prepare_task_prompt(task: dict) -> str and _validate_submission(code: str, agent: str, task: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[bool, list] keep their current signatures. BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES is already imported at harness/orchestrator.py:1955 (from harness.planner.taxonomies). The patch parser git_integration._parse_patches is already used in the existing partial_edit branch at orchestrator.py:935.
non_goals: Do not change general task scheduling or execution logic.
Do not modify any file other than harness/orchestrator.py.
Do not change the fuzzer-bypass smoke/embedded/narrow-fuzz gating at orchestrator.py:1783+.
Do not alter the BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES set definition (it lives in harness.planner.taxonomies).
spec.objective: Make any task whose resolved meta_task_type is in BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES (the differential fuzzer is bypassed) automatically behave like a partial_edit task in both the prompt-dispatch (prepare_task_prompt) and submission-validation (_validate_submission) flows, so fuzzer-bypassed infra edits use surgical __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ named-symbol/region patches instead of full-file __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ verbatim writes.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Synthetic task dicts: (a) bypass-eligible meta_task_type drawn from BYPASS_FUZZER_TYPES with single and multi-file files_touched; (b) partial_edit=True task; (c) meta_task_type nested under constraints; (d) plain multi-file non-bypass task; (e) plain single-file non-bypass task. Sample submission strings: a valid __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ list literal, a valid __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ dict literal, and a plain single-file source. No external services; pure in-process calls to prepare_task_prompt and _validate_submission.

gemini_task.title: Fall back to partial_edit (__JANUSMASK_PATCHES__) for fuzzer-bypassed tasks in prepare_task_prompt and _validate_submission

token_budget_ratio.note: Implementation is two small conditional broadenings in one file; the bulk of effort and tokens is the test matrix covering both functions across bypass/partial_edit/manifest/single-file permutations, hence test_tokens at 2x implementation.

gemini_task.verification_command: python -m pytest tests/ -k "bypass or partial_edit or prepare_task_prompt or validate_submission" -q
